name: 14216 · Buffalo, NY
findings: ZIP 14216 (Buffalo) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14216 (Buffalo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14216 (Buffalo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
